name: management-research-kb
description: Local Zotero and Obsidian retrieval for evidence-grounded management research.

interface.shortDescription: Ground management research in local literature.
interface.longDescription: Indexes local Obsidian PDFs and Zotero metadata, builds linked knowledge notes, and orchestrates two evidence-aware Codex agents for ideation and writing.
defaultPrompt: Build linked knowledge notes from my local literature folders.
Use my knowledge base to develop a management research idea.
Draft an evidence-grounded paper section from my local sources.
